title: E Link CAT6 Pass Through RJ45 Connectors

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The E Link CAT6 Pass Through RJ45 Connectors offer a professional solution for terminating CAT6 Ethernet cables with speed and precision. The pass-through design allows network cable wires to pass completely through the connector, making it easier to verify correct wiring order before crimping. This significantly reduces installation errors and improves overall network performance.


Manufactured with high-quality polycarbonate housing and gold-plated contacts, these connectors ensure strong signal transmission, reduced crosstalk, and long-term durability. The connectors are compatible with standard CAT6 UTP cables and work seamlessly with pass-through RJ45 crimping tools.


Ideal for LAN installations, data centers, offices, ISPs, CCTV networks, and home networking, the E Link CAT6 Pass Through RJ45 Modular Plug is a reliable choice for technicians and installers across Bangladesh.


Key Features


  • Pass Through RJ45 design for easy and accurate wiring
  • Supports CAT6 high-speed Ethernet cables
  • Gold-plated contacts for stable signal transmission
  • Reduces wiring errors and installation time
  • Strong and durable polycarbonate connector body
  • Compatible with pass-through RJ45 crimping tools
  • Suitable for LAN, WAN, CCTV & structured cabling
